title: CodeParams
description: Code-book parameters describing the temporal blink pattern. See design doc §7.6.

ledCount.description: Number of LEDs in the fixture.

bits.description: Number of coded bit frames per cycle: ceil(log2(ledCount+1)) data bits, plus the FEC parity frames when fec != 'none'.

fec.description: Forward error correction wrapped around the Gray data word. 'secded': extended Hamming, distance 4 — a single misread bit frame is CORRECTED, a double is DETECTED and the cycle rejected (never miscorrected). Exists because the raw Gray codebook has distance 1: one decisively-wrong window otherwise decodes to a valid WRONG LED id. Omitted = 'none' (legacy code-books).

encoding.description: Index encoding scheme. 'gray': intensity blink code (§8.1) — LEDs on/off per Gray-code bit. 'gray-hue': same Gray frame plan carried by COLOR at constant brightness — ALL_ON white (per-track color reference), ALL_OFF green (chroma sync), data bit 1 red / 0 blue; for fixtures filmed in uncontrolled lighting, where the decoder discriminates by hue relative to the white frame instead of by intensity.

bitPeriodMs.description: Hold time per bit frame, in milliseconds.

syncPattern.description: Sync delimiter pattern. Currently only 'on_off' (one all-on frame, one all-off frame); modeled as enum so it remains extensible.

cycleFrames.description: Total frames per cycle: 2 (sync delimiter) + bits.
